title: Kwu Tung North, December 1982 -- FSSTL 279 pilot and extension

terrain.source: CEDD LiDAR DTM 2010/11 (flown 2010-12-01 to 2011-01-08), 0.5 m, tiles e827-e829 n840-n841, averaged to 1 m; around the knoll rebuilt from the 1981/83 spot heights
terrain.tier_reason: measured ground of 2010-12/2011-01, not of 1982: it stands in for the 1982 ground, which no source measures; checked against the spot heights of the 1981/83 sheets, which draw no contours in the pilot (below). 0.88 ha around the knoll (E 828163-828346, N 840843-840908) rebuilt from the sheets' spot heights, raised up to 9.1 m (mean 5.3 m): the 2010/11 ground there appears to have been cut after Aug 1983 (an inference from the two spot heights it misses by 6.7-8.4 m).. Round the ponds the ground is lowered where the 1981/83 spot heights prove later fill (10.37 ha, up to 2.7 m). Inside the 48 ponds the ground is set flat to a drawn water level (no source gives the 1982 level). Along the river the ground is set to a drawn water level that falls in steps of at most 0.19 m
terrain.notes: averaged to 1 m cells; 0 nodata cells filled from their nearest neighbour

patch.what: ground rebuilt from the spot heights of sheets 2-SE-9B (1981) and 2-SE-4D (1983) where the 2010/11 DTM lies more than 2 m below them
patch.why: spot heights 19.4 mPD at E 828244 N 840865, 16.7 mPD at E 828270 N 840872: the DTM misses them by -8.4 m, -6.7 m; the Dec 1982 photo shows dense trees there; the ground there appears to have been cut after Aug 1983 (an inference)
patch.method: linear (Delaunay) interpolation of all 48 spot heights; the connected area below them by more than 2 m that holds those spots; feathered over 5 m; only raised
patch.limits: a surface of flat triangles between spot heights 26-72 m apart: the shape of the rise between them is not known; the sheets draw no contours here
patch.summary: 0.88 ha around the knoll (E 828163-828346, N 840843-840908) rebuilt from the sheets' spot heights, raised up to 9.1 m (mean 5.3 m): the 2010/11 ground there appears to have been cut after Aug 1983 (an inference from the two spot heights it misses by 6.7-8.4 m).

spot_height_check_built.what: the ground as built (after the patch) minus the 247 spot heights, after the fill round the ponds was lowered and the ponds levelled
spot_height_check_built.contours: the sheets draw no contours inside the pilot (session 2 reading): the spot heights are the whole check

SH074 6.7 mPD at E 828759 N 840988: ground +2.1 m

SH167 11.6 mPD at E 828833 N 841367: ground +2.9 m

SH170 8.5 mPD at E 828942 N 841153: ground +2.5 m

spot_height_check.what: this DTM minus the spot heights printed on sheets 2-SE-9B (1981) and 2-SE-4D (1983), tools/terrain_check.py
outliers: 19.4 mPD on the sheet at E 828244 N 840865, DTM -8.4 m
16.7 mPD on the sheet at E 828270 N 840872, DTM -6.7 m
spot_height_check.reading: matches the 1981/83 ground to about a metre except where the ground was cut or filled after 1983

fill_patch.what: the ground round the ponds lowered where the 1981/83 spot heights prove fill after them (the user's decision, 2026-10-18)
fill_patch.method: D = DTM minus the Delaunay surface of all 247 spot heights; the connected area where D > 1 m holding a proving spot, within 80 m of the ponds; lowered by D smoothed over 8 m (the 2010 relief kept), feathered over 10 m; only lowered
fill_patch.limits: between spot heights 30-80 m apart the 1982 surface is not known; the smoothing keeps 2010 relief, which may itself be later

ponds.what: the ground inside the 48 ponds of the model set flat, 0.4 m below the median ground on a 2 m bank round each: a water surface for the viewer
ponds.why: the 2010/11 DTM under a 1982 pond is not a water surface (ponds filled or drained since); no source gives the 1982 water level

rivers.what: the river (1 outline) cut into 20 m squares, 106 pieces, each with a raw level 0.4 m below the median ground on a 3 m bank round it; in order along the river from its upstream south end, fitted never to rise downstream (pool-adjacent-violators), averaged over 7 pieces along it and 20 times with the touching pieces: a water surface that falls along the river
rivers.why: no source gives the 1982 water level; the 2010/11 DTM along the 1982 channel is not its bed
rivers.banks: within 6 m of the water the ground is lowered (never raised) to at most 0.15 m above it plus 0.6 m per m: a sloped bank, not the sheer cut the 2010/11 ground left (3610 cells, up to 3.2 m): a drawing choice

ortho.source: LandsD DOP1000-1982 digital orthophoto, 0.1 m, flown Dec 1982 (data/orthophoto/dop1000_1982.tif, SOURCES.md 2), averaged to 0.2 m

extension.geometry_note: outline of the pilot and the extension together, as drawn on the map; extension_boundary.geojson holds the extension as drafted
extension.name: The viewer's whole map rectangle (extension of the FSSTL 279 pilot, widened 2026-10-25, east edge moved to E 829 450 the same day)
extension.edges: E 828 000-829 450, N 840 470-841 430 (EPSG:2326): the map rectangle, not a natural or surveyed edge

finishes.tile_note: drawing default: the patch's size in metres is not measured; 2.0 m x 0.97 m keeps its aspect
finishes.source: Gwulo.com media/14358, 'Army Housing site. Dills Corner Camp 1975' (uploader '70s kid'): a 1975 rooftop photograph of this estate, which shows its white render (viewer_1982/matching_register.json AR01)
finishes.note: Which block the photo shows is not known; the 25 blocks are one design (sheet 2-SE-9B; S22). The Dec 1982 colour is not established: white in 1975, pink by 2019 (DEVB photos, S32); the nearer date is shown, in neutral white because the faded print's hue is not reliable. No windows or doors are drawn: no record gives their positions on this block.
finishes.decided: the user, 2026-10-16, after the mockup (work/mockup/viewer_archival/): keep the 1975 white finish with no windows
finishes.drawn_with: CC0 Poly Haven white_stucco_02 (S36), brought to the brightness of the 1975 white (its mean, a colour, not the photo): white render, as the 1975 photograph (Gwulo 14358, AR01) shows it, cited, not shown

finishes.tile_note: drawing default: the patch is about 0.85 x 1.45 m if the hut wall it comes from is ~2.5 m high (not measured)
finishes.finish: walls: weathered sheet over timber (analogue texture, not this structure)
finishes.source: the author's field photo IMG_5720 (analogue_uses.json AN04, Ho Sheung Heung, 2026); material chosen from the 1962 HKU photos of Sheung Shui squatter huts and the Kwu Tung market (AR13, AR16-AR20) and the LandsD materials list (AR07)
finishes.note: ANALOGUE: not this structure's wall. No record shows the walls of any pilot hut; the 1982 Squatter Survey record of each structure would. Wood and sheet are what the 1962 local photos and the LandsD list support; the texture itself is a 2026 hut in another village. Tinted with the analogue tier colour.
finishes.decided: the user, 2026-10-16 ('yes' to analogue wall textures for temporary structures); AN04 chosen by Claude against the 1962 references, for the user to veto

finishes.finish: roof: the Dec 1982 aerial photograph of this roof
finishes.source: LandsD DOP1000-1982 orthophoto, flown Dec 1982 (S03), sampled at 0.2 m
finishes.note: The roof as photographed in Dec 1982: black and white, with its own shadows and clutter. Sampled on the footprint itself; the photo's lean (roofs ~1 m north of the ground outline, more on the 7 m estate blocks) can put a strip of ground or shadow along one edge. Walls keep the tier colour: no record shows them.
finishes.decided: Claude, 2026-10-16, on the user's request to texture the other pilot buildings; walls unchanged (no record of them); estate roofs included (the 1982 photo is nearer the epoch than the 1975 print)
finishes.shift_rule: the photo is sampled at the footprint moved by the roof's lean: (1) the shift of the fitted roof the author accepted (roof_fit_verdicts.json: 'use fitted', 'use fitted as rectangle'); (2) else the rigid shift of the fitted roof, confidence high or medium (work/viewer_1982/roof_fit/fitted.geojson); (3) else the median shift of the 5 nearest high-confidence fits
finishes.shift_mode_why: measured 2026-10-16 (tools/roof_photo_qc.py, work/viewer_1982/archival/roof_photo_scores.json): with the fitted roof shifts the roof edges on the photo are weaker for 98 of the 160 buildings (median edge strength 99 against 102 unshifted) and the dark share inside a roof rises from 3.5 % to 5.6 %; on the author's outlines drawn on the photo, which need no shift, unshifted wins 7 of 9. So the photo is sampled on the footprint itself. The shift_rule below is kept for when the roofs are moved back to the ground by their lean (outline_refinement.md, T4, the author's decision pending): then each roof's image lies north of its footprint and must be sampled there

roofs.note: roof forms from viewer_1982/roof_forms.json (two readers, Dec 1982 photo); pitch a drawing default; eaves at top_m, ridge at roof_ridge_m

water.channels: R ponds and the river, G cultivated plots, B lanes and yards; the rest grass
water.source: the land cover of the model: ponds, cultivated plots and yards (outlines from the 1:1000 sheets, read on DOP1000-1982), the open water of the river (traced off DOP1000-1982 by two tracers), lanes (centrelines read off the sheets)
water.appearance: still water reflecting the sky over the photo's own tone: a drawing choice, not a record of the water

ground_detail.source: the author's photographs, Long Valley, 2026-07-19 (grass IMG_5099, soil IMG_5078, lanes IMG_5077); tone removed, grain only; water ripples drawn by code (tools/evidence_ground.py)
ground_detail.note: generic surface grain within ~30 m of the eye, chosen by the sourced land cover (cultivated plots: soil; lanes and yards: concrete path; elsewhere: grass); every tone is still the Dec 1982 photo's. Not a record of the 1982 surface.
